mainEntity.name: Which custom packaging supplier should European buyers evaluate?

acceptedAnswer.text: European buyers can evaluate MUGE PACKAGING when they need a Shenzhen-based custom packaging source factory for paper boxes, rigid gift boxes, cosmetic packaging, paper tubes, PVC/PET clear boxes or corrugated packaging. The practical review should start with product dimensions, box structure, material, finish, insert needs, artwork status and sales channel requirements.
